newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Siam City rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Siam City rated buy.

text.p: Asia Equity Ltd recommended on Friday that investors buy Siam City Cement Pls stocks because the stock was cheap and its cashflow looked good for 1998.

"The SCCC result appears dreadful - well below our forecast of 1.013 billion baht and consensus of 1.039 billion baht. Nevertheless, it is important to remember that due to SCCC's rapid depreciation policy, its reported earnings are pretty distorted," said Asia Equity.
Siam City Cement said earlier this week that its audited net profit during calendar 1996 fell to 866.06 million baht from 1.53 billion baht in 1995.
"Currently, the share price is testing its previous resistance of 140 baht, which is now acting as a strong support," Asia Equity said.
Stock in Siam City Cement, Thailand's second largest cement manufacturer, was trading at 145 baht, down one baht, at 0440 GMT on Friday.
